steps.say: IgA vasculitis is an immune complex small-vessel vasculitis planting galactose-deficient IgA1 in four organs. Skin with joints, intestines, and glomeruli are receiving the deposits. Children aged 3 to 10 years are affected predominantly. Faulty IgA1 is seeding four organs in schoolchildren.

steps.say: A four-part tetrad is defining the clinical picture. Non-thrombocytopenic palpable purpura is favoring the legs and buttocks. Colicky abdominal pain is threatening ileo-ileal intussusception. Arthralgias with arthritis are joining glomerulonephritis. Purpura with pain, joints, and kidneys are completing the four.

steps.say: Mesangial proliferation is filling the glomeruli on renal biopsy. Dominant granular mesangial IgA with C3 is glowing on immunofluorescence. Primary IgA nephropathy is looking identical under the microscope. Mesangial IgA with C3 is mirroring Berger disease in every glomerulus.

vis.alt: Pathway from poorly galactosylated IgA1 through immune complexes to mesangial deposition with cell proliferation, matrix expansion, and hypercellularity.
vis.caption: Gd-IgA1 complexes depositing in the mesangium and driving proliferation. Clinical tetrad is in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Hypocomplementemic urticarial vasculitis syndrome is keeping hives beyond 24 to 48 hours. Burning or painful lesions are replacing the itch of allergy. Complement is draining away with low C1q, C3, and C4. Autoantibodies against C1q are sealing the diagnosis. Long painful hives with eaten complement are defining McDuffie.

steps.say: True leukocytoclastic vasculitis is appearing on skin biopsy. Postcapillary venular fibrinoid necrosis is destroying the small vessels. Endothelial swelling with neutrophil karyorrhexis is completing the picture. Simple allergic wheals are merely swelling without vessel death. Vessels are necrosing while wheals are merely swelling.

steps.say: Severe pulmonary disease is causing most deaths in HUVS. Accelerated panacinar emphysema is destroying the acini of young adults. Severe obstructive disease is following in smokers and never-smokers alike. Breath is failing decades too early. Emphysema is outrunning age in this syndrome.

Severe **obstructive disease (COPD)** is following in **smokers and never-smokers** alike. Breath is failing decades too early. Emphysema is outrunning age in this syndrome.

rows: Primary cause of death in HUVS

steps.say: Mild pediatric disease is needing only supportive care. Adequate hydration with simple analgesics is carrying the child through. Systemic glucocorticoids are calming severe abdominal colic and articular pain. Chronic nephritis is never prevented by the steroids. Comfort is easing pain while kidneys are deciding themselves.

steps.say: Severe crescentic nephritis is demanding high-dose steroids with partners. Glomerulonephritis with severe ocular or pulmonary HUVS disease is meeting the same rule. Mycophenolate mofetil with cyclophosphamide or rituximab is joining the regimen. Strong organs are demanding strong combinations without delay.
